source: [AS] [AS] two GT28-class turbos, one per bank; template twin_small.json with target_boost_bar 0.95 bar gauge = the highest-torque envelope row's MAP maximum (198.0 kPa abs, [M]) minus ISA 101.325 kPa, floored to 0.05 bar.
